description: The one docker command that joins a box to the Grid for a given wallet and resource kind. Returns the command and what each env var means. Nothing runs from this tool; the operator runs it on their box.

owner.description: 0x wallet that earns the GRID points

ref.description: Optional: 0x wallet that referred this box (TAIFOON_REF). Earns a share of what the box accrues.

name: taifoon_node_command
